MOOM: Maintenance, Organization and Optimization of Memory in Ultra-Long Role-Playing Dialogues

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Primarily a memory-extraction method (MOOM), but the paper also contributes ZH-4O, a Chinese ultra-long (avg ~600 turns) role-play dialogue dataset with manually annotated memory information used to evaluate memory extraction; repo has data folder and evaluation script.
